MlxStdFmt.PrintSignature: fn print(writer: anytype, comptime format: []const u8, args: anytype) !void
MlxStdFmt.Arguments: The args value is a comptime-specialized tuple or struct. Each replacement field consumes one field from args in declaration order.
MlxStdFmt.AnyFormatting: {any} recursively formats the concrete value using its default representation. Struct fields retain their names and declaration order; tuples omit field names; arrays and slices retain element order.
MlxStdFmt.Recursion: When the maximum depth is reached, aggregate contents are represented by an ellipsis.
MlxStdFmt.Validation: Format strings are parsed at comptime. Arity/type/specifier mismatches are compile errors.
MlxStdFmt.CustomFormatting: pub fn format(self: Self, writer: anytype, comptime spec: []const u8) !void
